threads.body: The shared `@opentelemetry/api` entry remains at 1.9.1, so upgraded instrumentation and exporter dependencies outside `scenario-sdk` resolve an API version below their required `>=1.10.0 <1.11.0` range. The 1.10.0 copy nested under `scenario-sdk` is not visible to those packages, leaving incompatible peers in the committed dependency tree. Update the shared API entry to 1.10.0 so those dependencies resolve a supported version.

replies.body: Fixed in 4a7a106f. The shared `@opentelemetry/api` entry is now `1.10.0`, and there is no separate API copy under `scenario-sdk`. The SDK and upgraded exporters resolve the shared, compatible version.
